pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Tarrasch Defense, Pseudo-Tarrasch Bishop Attack
pages.notes: Overview and plans called 5.Bg5 a pin; it attacks the d8-queen directly. Plan 2 wrote e4 as a move. Rewrote overview sentence and both plans; British spelling, including Tarrasch Defence.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Vienna Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 took on c3 with no knight there yet. Rewrote both plans (block with Nc3 or Nbd2; ...dxc4 and ...c5); British spelling, including Ragozin Defence.

pages.name: QGD: Alatortsev, 5.Bf4 c6 6.e3 Bf5
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote e5 as a move and had a knight on f8 controlling e5; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Alapin Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote e4 as a Black move and called the bishop fianchettoed before ...Bb7; plan 2 wrote Bb7 as a White move. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Charousek Variation, Miladinovic Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured on f3 with a bishop that cannot reach it and pushed an e4-pawn White no longer has. Rewrote it; British spelling. Overview now says the f-file is half-open.

pages.name: Semi-Slav: 4.cxd5 exd5 5.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview called the c1-bishop light-squared; plan 2 stopped a ...e5 break Black has no e-pawn for; plan 3 jumped a knight from g8 to e4; plan 4 called Black's light-squared bishop bad in the Carlsbad. Fixed all; British spelling.

pages.name: Semi-Slav: 4.e3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn; plans used 0-0 and wrote ...dxc4 Bxc4 loosely. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling, including Semi-Slav Defence.

pages.name: Semi-Slav: Marshall Gambit, 4...dxe4
pages.notes: Overview said White gives up the e-pawn (it is the d-pawn in the main line); plan 1 used an open e-file that is closed; plan 3 used an f1-rook that is on h1. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Semi-Slav: Marshall Gambit, 8.Be2 Na6
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed ...Nd7 with the b8-knight already on a6 and the other on g8. Rewrote it.

pages.name: Semi-Slav: Marshall Gambit, 8.Ne2
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed Be3 with the dark-squared bishop on b4 and the other on f1; plan 2 put both ...Na6 and ...Nd7 from b8; plan 3 lifted a rook from e1. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.
